what: Analysis and Simulation of the Card Game Skat
title: Analysis and Simulation of the Card Game Skat
text: skatR toolkit analysing simulating German card game Skat. provides trick play scoring suit, grand, null games, game-value computation, players spanning rule-based heuristics determinized Monte Carlo exact double-dummy solver, Monte Carlo simulation many deals, tidy analysis visualisation outcomes. caller supplies resolved contract final ten-card hands plus skat. Bidding, skat pickup/discard decisions, overbidding, tournament manager outside current engine. sk_ruleset() stores variant metadata; play scoring consume Bock, Ramsch, Kontra settings. Hand games include skat declarer’s card points matador count. Automatic values include achieved Schneider/Schwarz; announced levels ouvert checked explicitly. Corrected scores can differ earlier releases. game_value means complete scoring value, player’s bid.

text: sk_solve_dd(): exact double-dummy endgame solver (Rcpp alpha-beta). Returns card points declarer can guarantee perfect defence, counting points declarer’s cards. search carries transposition table move ordering. table keyed three hand masks plus trick progress stores declarer collects position onward, independent points already banked; every slot holds full key, hash collision misses rather answering different position. Move ordering tries cards take trick first, highest first. optimisations : values returned unchanged, tests/testthat/test-solver.R pins hand-traced positions, set five- six-trick values recorded previous solver, agreement independent minimax written R rules engine. Measured machine (R 4.6.1, x86_64 Linux, g++ 13.3, -O2), solving last n cards hand sk_deal(seed = s) declarer lead: whole twenty-position sweep (four eight cards per hand, grand clubs, two deals ) total falls 164.3 s 0.23 s, every one twenty values unchanged. Small positions slower: four-card ones come 0.4-0.6 ms either way. Whole ten-trick deals never benchmarked old solver finish reasonable time; twenty sampled deals now solve 0.06-12.8 s, median 0.33 s. sk_solve_dd() gains max_tricks (default 8), rejects position deeper given number cards per hand instead starting search may finish. error suggests slicing endgame, guard can raised 10 solve whole deal.
